description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the TenantObject class, verifying its deserialization, trust anchor handling, adapter enablement logic, resource limits, and other configurations within the org.eclipse.hono.util package.

classes.name: TenantObjectTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of TenantObject, including trust management, adapter enablement, and configuration deserialization.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Set up trust store and load CA certificate before all tests.

methods.name: getCaCertificate
methods.description: Helper method to load X509 CA certificate from trust store.

methods.name: testDeserializationOfCustomAdapterConfigProperties
methods.description: Test deserialization of tenant configuration JSON with custom adapter properties.

methods.name: testDeserializationOfEmptyTrustedAuthoritiesArray
methods.description: Test deserialization when trusted-ca array is empty.

methods.name: testDeserializationOfPublicKeyTrustAnchors
methods.description: Test trust anchor deserialization from Base64 encoded public key.

methods.name: testIsAdapterEnabledForEmptyConfiguration
methods.description: Test that all adapters are enabled if no specific config is provided.

methods.name: testIsAdapterEnabledForDisabledTenant
methods.description: Test that all adapters are disabled when tenant is marked disabled.

methods.name: testIsAdapterEnabledForNonEmptyConfiguration
methods.description: Test that only configured adapters are enabled.

methods.name: testGetTrustAnchorsUsesPublicKey
methods.description: Test that trust anchor uses configured public key and subject DN.

methods.name: testGetTrustAnchorFailsForInvalidBase64EncodingOfPublicKey
methods.description: Test behavior when public key Base64 encoding is invalid.

methods.name: testGetMaxTTDFromAdapterConfiguration
methods.description: Test retrieval of maximum time until disconnect from adapter extension configuration.

methods.name: testGetMaxTTDReturnsDefaultValue
methods.description: Test fallback to default max TTD when not set.

methods.name: testGetMaxTTDReturnsDefaultValueInsteadOfIllegalValue
methods.description: Test fallback to default max TTD when set to negative value.

methods.name: testGetResourceLimitsWhenNotSet
methods.description: Test behavior when resource limits are not configured.

methods.name: testGetMinimumMessageSize
methods.description: Test retrieval of minimum message size when configured.

methods.name: testGetMinimumMessageSizeNotSet
methods.description: Test default value for minimum message size when not configured.
